item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00416","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C07","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 is the concrete administrative foundation and drafting template for the child. The child expressly addresses officials performing functions delegated or vested by a masked directive, and C04 is the immediately preceding order delegating Defense Production Act functions to substantially the same officials. More distinctively, both instruments require those officials to consult the Attorney General and the Chairman of the Federal Trade Commission while administering the Act. The child broadens that consultation mechanism from C04's voluntary-agreement provisions into a general competition-protection policy and adds periodic reporting. C07 strongly supplies the child's substantive antimonopoly framing and repeated 1947 language, but it provides less of the operative administrative machinery.
